shadows.name: box
shadows.purpose: A hairline box, barely lifted: every resting container and the chosen segment. Never a hover state.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A box pulled forward: sheet, desk alert, sign-in card, receipt, demo orb. Nothing lifts on hover.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Content arriving (fade-in via @starting-style), a row leaving (fade and 0.5rem drift).

motion.name: dur-5
motion.purpose: A live count rolling over (LiveCount: from the direction of change, 0.04em blur).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one curve for nearly everything: state transitions, press scale 0.98, content fade, row leave, count roll, seg pill, shake steps.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: The sheet slide-in (0.24s); no overshoot. Slide-out 0.16s on ease-out.

motion.name: skeleton-breathe
motion.purpose: Loading placeholders; never a sweeping gradient.

motion.name: signin-refused
motion.purpose: The sign-in card shakes once beside the red message.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: The dot in a live pill; only while a call is live.

motion.name: demo-ring
motion.purpose: The demo orb while SHEFA is on the call; never at rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: loops stop; nothing slides or scales; colour and opacity still fade; every animation ends on its visible state

breakpoints.name: phone-shell
breakpoints.purpose: Rail becomes a top bar and a bottom tab bar; legend repeats on the page.

breakpoints.name: phone-records
breakpoints.purpose: Tables stack into labelled records; a doctor's day becomes a one-patient-per-screen feed.

themes.mechanism: prefers-color-scheme: dark applies unless :root[data-theme="light"]; :root[data-theme="dark"] forces dark.
themes.switch: frontend/src/lib/theme.tsx: auto | light | dark, stored in localStorage "shefa.theme" (auto removes it), applied before first paint.

patterns.leave: Session on leave: background none, border 1px dashed var(--rule-strong), label struck through in ink-2.
patterns.focus: outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px. Inputs: border var(--focus) + 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-wash).
patterns.sessionBar: Pill bar 0.5rem tall, background color-mix(in oklch, var(--doc) 16%, var(--box)); fill in var(--doc); count above the bar as plain text; a full session adds the word "full" in ink-2, no ring.
patterns.callbacksActive: Title in var(--urgent-ink); count a solid urgent pill; no header band, outline, glow or row wash.
patterns.doctorDot: ::before round dot, 0.55 to 0.6rem, background var(--doc); name in var(--ink) at 600.
patterns.hover: A surface step, never a shadow: buttons shade to box-2 with an ink-3 stroke; a hovered patient card firms its hairline to rule-strong.

narrative.overview:
SHEFA looks like a bright clinic desk that carries the labels of a Bangladeshi medicine shelf. Off-white boxes sit on a cool near-white field with slate ink, never cream. A light rail with a hairline edge runs down the staff app, and a light bar with a hairline beneath runs across the top of every public page. Boxes are edged by a 1px hairline rather than a drop shadow. Serials and references sit in quiet grey chips with tabular digits. Every doctor wears their own box colour across the whole product, carried as a small colour dot beside their name and as the fill of their session bars, so the desk finds a doctor's sessions, list and patients by colour, the way a pharmacist reaches for the right box.

Status is a printed legend: one colour, one meaning, everywhere, and always with words beside the colour. Red means a caller needs a person, or there is a clash or an error. Amber means waiting. Green means done. SHEFA violet means SHEFA itself: a live call, a booking it made, its side of a transcript. Gone is grey and struck through. One strong blue, outside the legend, is the colour of every action. The legend sits at the foot of the rail on desktop and repeats on the page on a phone.

The density is a working desk's, but friendly and local rather than austere. Bangla comes first. Type is one family, Hind Siliguri: semibold (600) for headings, names and the numbers that matter, regular for everything else. The round Baloo Da 2 survives only in the SHEFA wordmark. Corners are soft (8px and 12px), and boxes sit on the shelf inside a hairline with a barely-there lift. The world has a light theme and a navy-graphite dark theme that keeps the same blue and violet, lightened, chosen by the device or by the viewer.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white boxes on a cool near-white field; a light rail or top bar with a hairline.
One colour, one meaning: urgent red, waiting amber, done green, SHEFA violet, gone grey, always with words.
One strong blue for every action, kept apart from the legend.
Six doctor box colours, one per doctor, on every surface that names them.
Hairline-edged boxes, a colour dot beside each doctor's name, and quiet grey chips for serials.
Hind Siliguri throughout, semibold for headings and figures; Baloo Da 2 for the SHEFA wordmark only.
Light and navy-graphite dark themes, with a three-way theme switch (follow device, light, dark).

rules.name: The One Colour, One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each legend hue means one thing on every surface: red needs a person, amber waits, green is done, violet is SHEFA, grey struck through is gone. Blue stands outside the legend: it is the one colour of action, and it never means done. Never use a legend hue for decoration, and never let colour speak without a word beside it.

rules.name: The Box Colour Rule
rules.body: Doctors wear only the six doc colours, meant to sit clear of the legend hues. Steel (doc-2) sits where a violet once was, so no doctor shares SHEFA's hue. A doctor's colour appears wherever that doctor does (name dot, session bar fill, chip dot). A clash overrides the doctor's colour with urgent red.

rules.name: The Two Shelves Rule
rules.body: Every colour has a dark-theme value (see the sidecar). The theme is chosen by `prefers-color-scheme`, unless `:root[data-theme]` forces light or dark. Surfaces read tokens and never hard-code a light value. On the dark theme, text on a solid blue, green, violet or red fill turns dark (the on-primary, on-done, on-shefa and on-urgent values), so the fills keep their hue and stay legible.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Baloo Da 2 sets the SHEFA wordmark and nothing else. Headings, names, buttons, chips and figures are Hind Siliguri at 600; weight, not a second face, carries emphasis.

rules.name: The Tabular Digits Rule
rules.body: Times, serials, phone numbers, counts and tables always use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Live Ring Rule
rules.body: A ring only pulses while a call or a recording is live (the violet live orb, the dot in a live pill). Static strokes that mark a state are fine, such as the focus outline or the thin dashed outline of a session on leave. Decorative halos and glow rings at rest are not, and urgency is told by red words and a red count, not by a ring around the box.

dos: **Do** put words beside every status colour; a mark is always a dot plus a label.
**Do** give each doctor one of the six box colours and use it on every surface that names them.
**Do** use action blue for every primary action, settled green only for done, and SHEFA violet for what SHEFA is doing or did.
**Do** set serials and references in a quiet grey chip (box-2, ink-2, no border) with tabular digits.
**Do** keep corners on the scale: 8px controls, 12px boxes, pill for marks, chips and session bars.
**Do** mark a doctor with a small colour dot beside their name in ink, and edge boxes with the hairline, not a drop shadow.
**Do** use Lucide icons (lucide-react in the app; Lucide paths copied into static sprites) at 16 to 20px with a 2px stroke.
**Do** read every colour from tokens so both themes work, including rail-tint and rail-line for anything on the rail, and keep tap targets at least 44px.
**Do** keep metadata lines to at most one middle dot.
donts: **Don't** use a legend hue (red, amber, green, violet) or action blue as decoration, or give a new doctor a legend hue.
**Don't** pulse or glow a ring around anything at rest; a ring moves only while a call or recording is live.
**Don't** put em or en dashes in visible text.
**Don't** use Baloo Da 2 for anything but the SHEFA wordmark.
**Don't** reverse type out of a solid doctor colour, or wrap a box in a coloured outline or header bar to make it urgent.
**Don't** draw icons with text glyphs or emoji; use Lucide.
